title: Depth sweep: DEPTH=12 vs baseline 8
description: Increased DEPTH from 8 to 12 (model_dim auto-scales to 768, 6 heads); had to halve DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE to 64 to avoid CUDA OOM at this depth.
reflection: val_bpb 1.015989, slightly worse than baseline 1.014027. Under the fixed 5-minute wall-clock budget, the deeper/wider model (135M params vs presumably ~45M at depth 8) takes far more time per step and needed a smaller batch (more grad-accum overhead), so it saw fewer effective tokens/updates than the baseline. The extra capacity did not pay for itself in this short budget. This is consistent with a0's and a2's hypothesis that depth 8 is near or past the large-model side of the compute-optimal point for 5 minutes -- the group should now prioritize the DEPTH=6 (shrink) direction, which a0 and a2 both proposed, over further increases in depth.
